code.title: Code
code.description: HTTP 503: storage_busy (bounded lock contention), storage_io_error (IO/read-only/full), or storage_unavailable (other storage failures). Unknown codes retain the same error envelope and HTTP status.

username.title: Username
username.description: Omit to preserve; null rejected; trim to 3–24 code points

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Omit to preserve; null/trimmed empty clears; at most 49 code points

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 6 characters, with ASCII A–Z, a–z and 0–9; never trimmed

username.title: Username
username.description: Trimmed display name, 3–24 characters; duplicates allowed
